title: Halving
summary: The inverse problem to doubling, defined only when the ambient structure makes division by 2 meaningful or solvable.

title: Chirality
summary: Failure of an object to be superimposable on its mirror image using only orientation-preserving transformations.

title: Equivalence relation
summary: A precise way to declare when two elements are treated as the same for a specified purpose.

title: Invariant
summary: A quantity or property unchanged by a specified family of transformations.

title: Parity
summary: Classification of integers by their remainder modulo 2.

title: Periodicity of a sequence
summary: Exact repetition after a fixed positive index shift.

title: Prime number
summary: A positive integer greater than 1 with no positive divisors other than 1 and itself.

title: Quasiperiodicity
summary: A context-dependent form of recurrent nonperiodic behavior generated by multiple incommensurate periods or frequencies.

title: Recurrence relation
summary: A relation constraining indexed values using other indexed values, often earlier ones.

title: Sensitive dependence on initial conditions
summary: A metric dynamical property in which arbitrarily nearby starting states can eventually separate by a fixed positive amount.

title: Sequence
summary: An ordered family of values indexed by a specified set, usually the natural numbers.

title: Symmetry
summary: A transformation that leaves a specified object unchanged relative to a specified action.

title: Chaos
summary: A family of precise but non-equivalent dynamical notions rather than one universal predicate.

title: Closed form
summary: A widely used but non-universal label for formulas considered explicit relative to an allowed vocabulary of operations/functions.
